# Mặt Nạ Tuồng Việt Nam — AI Documentation for LLMs

> This file follows the llms.txt specification (https://llmstxt.org/).
> Last updated: 2026-08-24

## About

Tuong Mask Archive is a digital exhibition preserving and presenting 117 traditional Vietnamese Tuong (Classical Theater) masks. The project combines cultural heritage preservation with AI technology through an on-device Virtual Try-On experience.

## Project Summary

- **Name:** Mặt Nạ Tuồng Việt Nam (Vietnamese Tuong Masks)
- **URL:** https://tuongmask.vn/
- **Type:** Digital Art Exhibition / Cultural Heritage Archive
- **Language:** Vietnamese (vi-VN)
- **Collection size:** 117 Tuong masks
- **Technology:** React SPA, AI Virtual Try-On (WebAssembly / on-device, no data sent to servers)

## What Is Tuong?

Tuong (Hát Bội) is Vietnam's classical theater form, originating in the 10th century. Each mask represents a character archetype:
- **Red mask:** Loyalty, righteousness (trung nghĩa)
- **Black mask:** Steadfastness, integrity (cương trực)
- **White mask:** Cunning, deceit (gian tà)
- **Green mask:** Supernatural beings, forest spirits
- **Gold mask:** Divinity, royalty (thần linh, vương giả)

## Collection

The archive contains 117 digitized masks organized by category:
- Heroic characters (Nhân vật anh hùng)
- Villains (Nhân vật phản diện)
- Divine figures (Thần linh)
- Warriors (Võ tướng)
- Ministers (Văn thần)

## Features

1. **Gallery View:** Browse all 117 masks in a responsive grid
2. **Detailed View:** Full-screen mask detail with cultural context
3. **Discover Your Mask:** Interactive quiz to match users with a mask character
4. **AI Virtual Try-On:** Real-time camera overlay using on-device AI (MediaPipe + ONNX Runtime Web)

## Technical Notes

- All AI processing is 100% on-device (WebAssembly/WebGPU) — no camera data is ever sent to any server
- Images served in WebP format with PNG fallback
- Progressive Web App: installable, offline-capable via Service Worker
- WCAG 2.1 accessible with ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and focus indicators

## Content Policy

- All mask artwork is credited to the original artist: Hoàng Song Hào
- Content is free to access (isAccessibleForFree: true)
- No affiliate links, no advertising, no user tracking

## Contact

For inquiries about the collection or technical collaboration:
